alerts.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 18 at 1:05PM PST until November 20 at 9:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Surf of 4 to 6 feet. Sets to 8 feet along west-facing
beaches expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From Thursday morning through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Increased risk for rip currents. Areas of coastal
flooding possible during high tide each morning along
boardwalks and parking lots.
